title.zh: 删除存储空间的生命周期规则
title.en: Delete lifecycle rules of a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Bucket的拥有者才能删除该Bucket的生命周期规则。

- 调用DeleteBucketLifecycle接口删除指定Bucket所有的生命周期规则后，该Bucket中的文件（Object）不会被自动删除。
descriptions.en:
- Only the bucket owner can delete the lifecycle rules of the bucket.

- After you call the DeleteBucketLifecycle operation to delete all lifecycle rules of a specified bucket, objects in the bucket are not automatically deleted.
